entities.name: Lilē Zōgraphu
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Lili Zografou was a Greek journalist, novelist, dramatist, essayist, and political activist, best known for Nikos Kazantzakis: enas tragikos, her "destructive critique" of the work of Nikos Kazantzakis, published in 1959, three years after his death.
